Q: mean((z - inverse_transform(transform(z)))**2), in standardized feature space
JOINT: max(Q / a_Q, T2 / a_T), where both a values are Train q95(higher)
threshold: separate Calibration100 q95(higher) for each available policy
t2_rule: invalid if any retained eigenvalue is nonfinite or <= 1e-12 times the largest; no clipping
joint_rule: invalid if either Train scale is nonfinite or <= 1e-12; no fallback
full_dimension_q: reported explicitly, scores at numerical precision are not useful
